question: Estimate the number of premium/paying subscribers on dating apps (Tinder + Bumble + Hinge + others) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: All major dating apps combined? Yes (excludes matrimony like Shaadi, Jeevansathi).
Active subscriber (paid in last 30 days) or cumulative? Active.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: total dating app users India → free-to-paid conversion.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, men:women ratio ~75:25 = 7.5M men, 2.5M women.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, dating app users (any app, last 90 days)

calculationFlow: Of these, dating app users (any app, last 90 days): ~12% = ~10M.
Of these, men:women ratio ~75:25 = 7.5M men, 2.5M women.
